hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s re-election bid and economic defense
hotspots.blurb: Javier Milei rallies lawmakers to defend his economic policies ahead of critical congressional votes on Central Bank reform and other key legislation. His government faces internal tensions, public discontent over rising defaults, and a potential 2027 re-election campaign.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Milei's combative leadership style, high-stakes economic reforms, and the polarized public reaction to his policies.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration pauses global visa appointments, plans to revoke up to 200,000 visas of asylum seekers, and imposes a $103,000 fee for H-1B visas. These moves are part of a broader immigration enforcement strategy.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the scale of the crackdown, its impact on global mobility, and the moral outrage it provokes among critics.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern states, threatening to become the first far-right party to govern a German state. The party's policies include abolishing public broadcasting and restricting immigration.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the AfD's extremist rhetoric, its potential to reshape German politics, and the alarm it raises among mainstream parties and media.

hotspots.title: Italy’s Salvini pushes budget deficit and fuel tax battles
hotspots.blurb: Matteo Salvini, Italy’s Deputy Prime Minister, demands a €20 billion increase in the 2027 budget deficit and extends fuel tax cuts amid rising energy costs. His proposals face opposition from coalition partners and the EU.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Salvini’s confrontational leadership, the economic stakes of his proposals, and the internal divisions within Italy’s ruling coalition.

hotspots.title: Trump administration threatens Kennedy Center demolition
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration threatens to demolish the Kennedy Center if renovations, including adding Trump’s name, are not approved. The threat has sparked outrage from cultural institutions and lawmakers.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to the symbolic significance of the Kennedy Center, the audacity of the threat, and the polarized reactions it has provoked.
